Accel Atoms is Accel’s pre-seed and seed platform for early founders building for the next decade. Designed for ambitious founders, we offer capital, mentorship, and company-building support from Accel’s global network of investors and operators. Since launch, we’ve supported dozens of Indian & Indian diaspora founders, in categories spanning developer infrastructure to consumer, Industry 5.0 and AI. What are the different cohorts I can apply for? Accel Atoms is accepting applications for Atoms AI & Atoms X Cohorts. What is Accel Atoms AI? Accel Atoms AI is a pre-seed program for ambitious early-stage founders building across the AI stack. We’ve always wanted to change that. This is part of why we exist at all, and a question that we have tried to answer with whatever we have done. Over the past couple of years, Accel has been focusing deeply on building community-led initiatives for early stage entrepreneurs in the ecosystem.
